metadata.description: A deterministic gatekeeper CLI plus gated multi-agent workflows for Claude Code. The spin CLI never calls a model — it orders, gates, and routes the work while slash commands orchestrate Claude around CLI-enforced checkpoints. 17 agents, 1 knowledge base domain, 30 commands, 11 gates, model routing.

plugins.name: spindle
plugins.description: Deterministic spec-driven orchestration for Claude Code. The spin CLI is the spine (it never calls a model); slash commands orchestrate Claude around CLI-enforced gates. 17 agents, 1 knowledge base domain, 30 commands, 11 gates, model routing (Haiku/Sonnet/Opus), adversarial verification.
